name: Merdeka 118
status_detail: Operational · completed tower; park and later phases phased in
summary: The 678.9 m Merdeka 118 tower, the second-tallest building in the world, standing beside the historic Merdeka Stadium. Anchor of a mixed-use district including a park at its base.

scale.label: Rank
scale.value: Second-tallest completed building in the world

why_it_matters: It reshaped the KL skyline and tied the city's tallest new district to its independence-era heritage. The surrounding precinct is the largest urban redevelopment in the city centre.
questions_to_follow: Do the later phases (offices, hotel, park activation) fill up as planned?
Does the precinct successfully connect to the Pasar Seni/MRT area?

history.event: Tower structure completed; phased opening of park and observation deck follows.
